content:
erin: Published the incident write-up for the serving latency spike yesterday. RCA + action list is here: https://redwood.internal/rca/2209123456-serving-lag
sam: thanks erin  quick question: where are we on the cache eviction mitigation? same plan as discussed in the war room?
maria: owner for cache mitigation is @maria, ETA is end of week. I added the patch link in the doc.
infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary rollout of cache-tuning patch at 03:00 UTC tomorrow. Trigger: manual by @maria
maria: I'll run the canary and post status here. cc @ops @sre
ops: please include load test steps in the doc so we can validate post-deploy. small checklist would help.
erin: added a short runbook snippet to the doc under "canary validation". snippet:
```
# validation steps
1) replay production tail for 10m
2) confirm p95 latency < 450ms
3) watch eviction rate drop by >= 30%
```
sam: perfect. also assigning follow-ups:
- Maria: implement canary + notify (owner: @maria, due: 2026-04-03)
- Jae: add automated alert for cache-threshold regressions (owner: @jae, due: 2026-04-10)
- Priya: add customer-impact tag and update status page template (owner: @priya, due: 2026-04-07)
jae: I'll prototype the alert rule today and share the query in a follow-up thread.
priya: will update the statuspage template and ping comms for a pre-approved message.
erin: flagged a risk: quantized model variant may still have higher tail latency under long context. investigating fallbacks.
luis: would be good to list rollback criteria in the canary notes. otherwise :+1:
maria: adding rollback criteria now: if p95 > 600ms or error rate increases by >0.5% we abort.
sam: can we set a checkpoint sync next Monday to verify action progress? erin, can you host 30m?
erin: yes  scheduling: Monday 2026-04-06 15:00 PT, 30m. calendar invite sent.
ops: I'll join. marking as recurring if needed.
maria: starting canary tomorrow, will post results in this thread. thanks all :eyes:
bot: rca-published - link: https://redwood.internal/rca/2209123456-serving-lag - tags: reliability, cache, rollout
erin: closing note: please comment on the doc if you think we missed anything or need more context for the action items. we'll re-open the RCA if new findings surface.
